Ciphertext.description:
mp_base85 source ciphertext — the `c` envelope key.

Required by every v3 domain CHECK; present on every payload.

Identifier.description:
Table + column identifier — wire shape `{"t": "...", "c": "..."}`.

Shared by every payload.

OreBlock256.description:
Block-ORE order term — the `ob` wire key. Backs the `_ord` / `_ord_ore`
domains (`=` `<>` `<` `<=` `>` `>=`); ORE is lossless over the scalar's
domain, so it serves equality too. The block count is width-agnostic on the
wire (8 for the int scalars, 12 for timestamptz, 14 for numeric) — the
array just carries more block strings. SQL-side constructor:
`eql_v3.ore_block_256`.

SchemaVersion.description: The envelope version field (`v`) — always exactly `2` on the wire.

description:
`eql_v3.int4_ord_ore` — full comparison (`=` `<>` `<` `<=` `>` `>=`),
scheme-explicit name. Same shape as [`Int4Ord`], distinct SQL domain.

c.description: mp_base85 source ciphertext. Required by the domain CHECK.

i.description: Table/column identifier. Required by the domain CHECK.

ob.description:
Block-ORE order term. Serves equality too — ORE over a
full-domain `int4` is lossless, so no separate `hm` is carried.

v.description:
Envelope version — always `2` (`EQL_SCHEMA_VERSION`); any other
value fails deserialization.
